svg.text: What "tailoring" actually changes — the professional summary
Computer Engineering M.Sc. student and AI Engineer specializing in computer vision and edge deployment.
Experienced in using CUDA to run real-time inference on NVIDIA Jetson, and in training object detection
models with YOLO and TensorFlow. Builds end-to-end pipelines covering preparation, training and deployment.
AFTER · tailored for the NVIDIA Solutions Architect role (green = added / re-emphasised, still fact-checked)
Computer Engineering M.Sc. student and AI Engineer with hands-on experience deploying GPU-
accelerated computer vision solutions using NVIDIA CUDA and NVIDIA Jetson edge hardware. Skilled in
building end-to-end deep learning pipelines, with a strong foundation in optimization, real-time
inference, and cloud-ready infrastructure tools such as Docker and Linux.
